storyTitle: Design a Continuous Workflow for Feeding the Obsidian Vault
transverseRationale: Reusable across repositories because it defines a lightweight deterministic path from completed Story outcomes to proposal-only transverse-memory candidates without writing directly into the curated vault.
proposedSynthesis: Use a structured Story-local vault outcome plus a repository-owned proposal backlog to turn completed workflow outcomes into reviewable transverse-memory proposals with duplicate suppression.
curationNotes: This likely enriches the existing Fluid Knowledge Feeding Pipeline note by adding the steady-state Story-scoped workflow path that complements broad bootstrap extraction.
